summary: Traefik is an HTTP reverse proxy and load balancer designed to simplify the deployment of microservices. It automatically inspects your infrastructure to route incoming web traffic to the correct backend services without manual configuration files. Written in Go, it integrates natively with container platforms.
goodFor: It is a strong fit if you run containerised microservice architectures and want automated routing discovery.
watchOut: Dynamic configuration can occasionally complicate debugging when routing rules fail to resolve as expected compared to static proxies.
deployNotes: As a compiled Go binary typically run inside a container, it usually does not require an external database and handles TLS termination directly.
